settings.language.label: Language
signin.scopes.title: What each sign-in shares with AgentMux
signin.scopes.google: Google: your name, email address and profile picture (the openid, email and profile permissions).
signin.scopes.apple: Apple: your name, if you choose to share it, and your email address, or a private relay address if you choose Hide My Email (the name and email permissions). While AgentMux Cloud is invitation-only, choose Share My Email.
signin.scopes.neither: Neither gives AgentMux access to your Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, iCloud or anything else in your account.
signin.panel.note: ⓘ Sign in to AgentMux Cloud in your browser — one account per install, no key to manage.
signin.panel.signInNoLongerWorks: ⓘ The sign-in for {{who}} no longer works. Sign in again to reconnect.
signin.github.needsCloud: GitHub tokens for your agents come from AgentMux Cloud, so this needs your AgentMux Cloud account.
agentPicker.filters.label: Filter the new-agent cards
agentPicker.filters.disabledHint: Close the open panel to change the filters.
agentPicker.filterBar.name: Name (A–Z)
agentPicker.empty.title: No definitions configured
agentPicker.empty.desc: Use the ⚙ Agent settings to add your first definition.
agentPicker.templates.hint: Each card is a harness (the CLI that runs the agent, e.g. Claude Code, Codex) — you'll pick which model it uses next.
agentPicker.templates.managedNote: AgentMux installs and runs its own copy of each agent CLI, kept apart from any you installed yourself (to run yours instead, switch on "Use the CLI on my PATH" for it in Toolchain), and keeps each agent's login and settings in its own folders. This isolates the tools, not what an agent can do on your computer.
agentPicker.notices.nodeHint: After installing, restart AgentMux and try again.

agentCard.updateTitle: A newer CLI version is pinned by AgentMux — update it in the Toolchain pane
agentCard.newSessionTitle: Archive current session and start a new one
agentCard.newSessionLabel: Start a new session for {{name}} (archives the current one)
agentCreate.duplicateName: You already have an agent named {{name}}. Choose another name.
agentCreate.hint: {{name}} is the harness, the CLI tool that runs this agent. Pick which model it uses below; the harness stays the same either way.
agentCreate.name.label: Name
agentCreate.name.note: Name it for its job, like Reviewer or Docs writer, so you can tell your agents apart.
agentCreate.runtime.label: Runtime
agentCreate.runtime.containerNoDocker: Container (runs in Docker) — Docker not detected
agentCreate.runtime.note: Container: runs in Docker, sandboxed. Native: runs on this computer with your files and tools.
agentCreate.runtime.nativeOnly: {{name}} can only run as a Native agent.
agentCreate.image.label: Container image
agentCreate.image.standardNote: The smallest image: the agent, git, GitHub CLI and Python.
agentCreate.image.developerNote: Adds Rust, a C toolchain, go-task and a headless display, so the agent can build and run projects (about 660 MB to download, on top of the standard image).
agentCreate.model.label: Model
agentCreate.model.note: Which model {{name}} runs with. Changeable later from the agent pane's runtime picker.
agentCreate.vendor.label: Model Vendor / Custom Endpoint
agentCreate.vendor.note: Redirect this agent's harness at a custom API endpoint (e.g. a proxy or alternate model backend) instead of the default vendor. Leave blank to use the default.
agentCreate.bundles.label: Bundles
agentCreate.bundles.note: In order: when two bundles name the same skill, the first wins.
freeGuide.title: Use {{name}} for free
access.checked.aging.one: checked {{count}} day ago, may have changed
access.checked.aging.other: checked {{count}} days ago, may have changed
access.local.worked: Works in AgentMux's own test with {{model}} ({{date}}).
access.local.failed: Did not work in AgentMux's own test with {{model}} ({{date}}).
access.local.untested: Documented by the CLI, not tested by AgentMux.

login.pasteHint: After you authorize, the page shows a code — paste it here:
containerImage.note.denied: The container image can't be downloaded: its registry refuses access. New agents run as Native agents (on this computer) until that is fixed.
containerImage.note.notFound: The container image wasn't found in its registry. New agents run as Native agents (on this computer) until that is fixed.
containerImage.developer.denied: The developer image can't be downloaded: its registry refuses access. Pick the standard image, or try again later.
containerImage.developer.notFound: The developer image isn't published for this version of AgentMux yet. Pick the standard image, or update AgentMux.
containerCaches.label: Build cache
containerCaches.size.one: {{size}} in {{count}} volume: what {{name}}'s builds keep (the cargo registry and build output), so a new container or an image update does not start from nothing.
containerCaches.size.other: {{size}} in {{count}} volumes: what {{name}}'s builds keep (the cargo registry and build output), so a new container or an image update does not start from nothing.
containerCaches.large: That is a lot of disk. Clearing it frees the space; the next build starts cold.
containerCaches.cleared: Cleared: {{size}} freed. The container starts again at the agent's next message.
agentEnv.intro: The extra environment variables {{name}} starts with.
agentEnv.label: Environment
agentEnv.hint: One per line, NAME=VALUE; # starts a comment. Applies at the agent's next launch. Names starting AGENTMUX_ are reserved.
agentEnv.saved: Saved. It applies at the agent's next launch.
agentEnv.reason.badName: {{key}} is not a name: use letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit
settings.appearance.theme.label: Theme
settings.appearance.theme.description: Default UI color theme, for windows without one of their own (the ☰ menu sets one window's)
settings.appearance.splash.label: Startup splash screen
settings.appearance.splash.description: Show the AgentMux splash while the app starts. Applies at the next launch — the launcher reads this before the app itself is running.
settings.appearance.transparency.label: Window transparency
settings.appearance.opacity.label: Opacity
settings.appearance.opacity.description: Default window opacity (35–100%), for windows without one of their own (the ☰ menu sets one window's)
settings.appearance.blur.label: Background blur
settings.appearance.blur.description: Blur the content behind the window
settings.appearance.paneGap.label: Pane gap size
settings.appearance.bgColor.label: Background color
settings.appearance.bgColor.description: Custom background color override (hex). Leave blank to use the theme default.
settings.appearance.magnifiedOpacity.des: Background opacity of a pane while magnified (0–1)
settings.appearance.magnifiedSize.label: Magnified size
settings.appearance.magnifiedSize.descri: Scale factor applied to a pane while magnified
settings.appearance.magnifiedBlurPrimary: Backdrop blur, in pixels, applied to the magnified pane itself
settings.appearance.magnifiedBlurSeconda: Backdrop blur, in pixels, applied to the other panes behind it
settings.appearance.widgetColors.label: Widget colors
settings.appearance.widgetColors.descrip: The color of every pane of each widget type: its border, tabs and header. A pane's own Pane Color and an agent's color still win.
settings.language.description: The language of AgentMux's own screens. It does not change what agents reply in, and text from a hosted agent's terminal or tools stays in its own language. A language marked Beta shows English for what is not translated yet.
settings.rail.label: Settings section
settings.animations.preset.label: Animations
settings.animations.preset.description: Turn animations off, or make them quicker, smoother or slower. Applies at once in every window.
settings.animations.speed.label: Animation duration (%)
settings.animations.speed.description: How long animations take, as a percent of their designed timing. 0 is off; lower is quicker.
settings.animations.polish.label: Hover and fade polish (%)
settings.animations.polish.description: The length of hover and focus fades and hover lifts, as a percent of their designed timing. 0 is off.
settings.animations.reduceMovement.label: Reduce movement
settings.animations.reduceMovement.descr: Replace slides, zooms and bounces with fades.
settings.window.showBlockIds.label: Show block IDs
settings.window.showBlockIds.description: Show each pane's internal block ID in its header (debugging aid)
settings.window.defaultNewBlock.label: Default new block
settings.window.defaultNewBlock.descript: View type opened by default for new tabs/panes (e.g. term, agent, shortcuts)
settings.window.showPaneNumberOverlay.de: Show numbered overlays for quick pane-jump shortcuts
settings.window.mouseSideButtons.label: Mouse side buttons select the previous / next pane
settings.window.mouseSideButtons.descrip: Back and Forward re-select the pane you had selected before or after, in any tab. Ctrl + button is page back / forward over a browser pane
settings.window.showStatusBar.label: Show the status bar
settings.window.showStatusBar.descriptio: The bar along the bottom with the backend dot, system stats, token and history totals, and the version. Hiding it frees a row of space; it comes back by itself if the backend goes down, and "Toggle Status Bar" in the command palette flips it
settings.window.confirmTabClose.label: Confirm before closing a tab
settings.window.confirmTabClose.descript: Ask before closing a tab, instead of closing it at once
settings.window.confirmCloseWorking.labe: Warn before closing a window with working agents
settings.window.confirmCloseWorking.desc: Ask before closing a window while an agent in it is mid-turn. Closing stops its agents; the window stays in the workspace, to reopen from the version panel
settings.browser.profiles.label: Browser profiles
settings.browser.profiles.description: Each profile keeps its own sign-ins, cookies and site data, so one site can be open as two accounts side by side. Open a tab in one from the Profile button in a browser pane. Personal is the one every tab started with; it can't be removed. An agent can browse as a profile only if you switch on "Agents may use it" for that profile; on Windows it can also use an Incognito tab.
settings.browser.searchSuggestions.label: Search suggestions while typing
settings.browser.searchSuggestions.descr: The address bar also asks your search engine for suggestions as you type, as Chrome does, which sends it what you type before you press Enter. Incognito tabs never ask, as in Chrome. Turn it off to keep suggestions to this computer (your history and the addresses you typed).
settings.browser.hibernate.label: Hibernate hidden browser panes
settings.browser.hibernate.description: A browser pane out of sight for a while goes to sleep: its page is put away to free its memory, often 100 to 200 MB, and loads again when you're about to look at it, with a note while it restores. It comes back with its back/forward history, scroll position and anything typed into it, on browser engines that support it; on older ones it loads fresh. Never a pane an agent is using, one playing or capturing media, one with something typed into it, or a local dev server.
settings.browser.hibernateAfter.label: Minutes hidden before it sleeps
settings.browser.hibernateAfter.descript: Sooner when the computer is low on memory: 5 minutes, then 1.
settings.browser.keepAwakeSites.label: Sites that never sleep
settings.browser.keepAwakeSites.descript: Browser panes on these sites stay awake however long they are hidden. A site covers its subdomains (example.com covers mail.example.com); write an address with https:// to keep just that one.
settings.browser.pauseAll.label: Pause all agent browsing
settings.browser.pauseAll.description: An emergency stop: while it is on, every browser pane an agent drives refuses every call the agent makes, and the clocks of auto-approve grants stand still. It stays on after a restart until you turn it off here, in the status bar or from the command palette.
settings.terminal.defaultShell.label: Default shell
settings.terminal.defaultShell.descripti: The shell new local terminals open with. Agents' shells and SSH or WSL terminals keep their own.
settings.terminal.fontSize.label: Font size
settings.terminal.fontFamily.label: Font family
settings.terminal.terminalTheme.label: Terminal color theme
settings.terminal.scrollback.label: Scrollback lines
settings.terminal.scrollback.description: Number of lines kept in terminal scrollback (1000–100000)
settings.terminal.copyOnSelect.label: Copy on select
settings.terminal.copyOnSelect.descripti: Automatically copy selected text to clipboard
settings.terminal.shiftEnterNewline.desc: In a terminal: Shift+Enter sends a newline instead of running the line
settings.terminal.durableSsh.label: Keep SSH sessions alive
settings.terminal.durableSsh.description: Durable SSH terminals keep their shell running on the host (in AgentMux's small helper there), so a dropped link, sleep or a restart reconnects instead of ending it. On a host without the helper, the first terminal asks before installing it, and is a plain terminal if it isn't installed. Connectors → Remotes can set it per host.
settings.terminal.helperInstall.label: Install the helper on new hosts
settings.terminal.helperInstall.descript: Durable terminals and file browsing on an SSH host need AgentMux's small helper there. Ask before installing it, install it without asking, or never install it. Each host can override this in Connectors → Remotes, and an agent's install is always asked about.
settings.terminal.bracketedPaste.label: Bracketed paste
settings.terminal.bracketedPaste.descrip: Allow programs to detect pasted text vs. typed text
settings.terminal.terminalTransparency.d: Terminal background transparency (0 = opaque, 1 = fully transparent)
settings.terminal.scrollSensitivity.desc: Scroll wheel speed multiplier for terminal panes (0.1–10, default 1). Independent of the OS scroll-speed setting.
settings.terminal.cpuMemBadge.label: Show CPU/mem badge
settings.terminal.cpuMemBadge.descriptio: Show a live CPU%/memory usage badge in the top-right corner of terminal panes
settings.terminal.predictiveEcho.label: Predictive echo
settings.terminal.predictiveEcho.descrip: Show local predictive echo of typed characters while waiting on a slow/remote shell
settings.terminal.predictiveEchoThreshol: Round-trip latency (ms) above which predictive echo kicks in
settings.terminal.agentMaxRuntime.label: Agent max runtime
settings.terminal.agentMaxRuntime.descri: Hours before the watchdog kills a long-running agent pane. 0 = no limit.
settings.terminal.agentIdleTimeout.label: Agent idle timeout
settings.terminal.agentIdleTimeout.descr: Minutes of PTY silence before the watchdog kills an idle agent pane. 0 = no limit.
settings.animations.help.system: Uses your computer's setting. Windows: Settings, Accessibility, Visual effects, Animation effects. macOS: Accessibility, Display, Reduce motion.
settings.animations.reducedNotice: Your system asks for reduced motion. AgentMux is not following it because you chose {{choice}}.
settings.animations.advancedHelp: The numbers below are what Follow system uses now (from your system). Choose another option to set your own.
settings.animations.snapped: {{raw}} is out of range: using {{next}}. Use 0, or {{min}} to {{max}} in steps of {{step}}.
settings.animations.preview.card: A card that slides and fades in
settings.animations.preview.panel: A panel that collapses and opens
